passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: Binding RPS mandate with firm percentage deadlines; matches rung 1's mandate-and-deadline clauses, not merely the bill's separate 2045 policy goal.
Gabriel is listed Aye on the Assembly floor final-passage vote; Noes (33) exceed 10%, so the vote is not near-unanimous.

rows.reasoning: Gabriel voted Aye in the Assembly floor final-passage vote on SB 100 (Ayes Count 44 Noes Count 33), a single-subject clean-energy bill whose operative RPS section binds retail sellers to firm percentage deadlines ("the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress ... achieves ... by December 31, 2016 ... 60 percent by December 31, 2030"), matching the rung text 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines.'
